title: Kononenkogroup lines
description: Text whose lines rise into place from behind their own masks as they come up from the bottom of the window (or once on load, for the first screen), on a long soft ease-out. Works for 12px labels and 130px headlines alike. CSS only: each word's mask is its own view timeline, so the words of one line rise together.
notes: takes plain text (split on spaces) or a list of forced lines
CSS only: without scroll-driven animations, or with reduced motion, the text simply stands
the masks leave room for ascenders and descenders down to a leading of about 0.7
